verdict.rationale: AiPrise is a SaaS identity and compliance verification platform, so an official CLI is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence documents only a hosted web flow, mobile SDKs, REST APIs, a dashboard and an llms.txt file. None of these is an official command-line tool, and APIs, SDKs and llms.txt are adjacent building blocks that earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
